Sonic Racing CrossWorlds · CSS Order Builder

Drag characters into the order you want on the character select screen, then download a ready-to-install mod. Everything runs in your browser.

Selected: Move to slot
    This is how your select screen will be ordered. 🔒 Locked characters (AI color 2 & 3, DLC you don't have yet) can go anywhere: the game shows them at the end only until you unlock them, then they take the slot you gave them. AI racers in pop-ups and Sage (black) don't take a slot (use List view for them).

    1 · Download your mod

    Quick arrangements

    Edit as text

    One character per line, top = first slot. Anything after ; is just a label. Characters you leave out keep their order after the ones you list.

    Pop-ups (AI racers)

    Click Pop-up on an AI racer to take it off the main grid and put it inside its character's pop-up (like Separate, AI Skins! does); Grid gives it its own icon again. Everyone stays unlocked. Characters tagged UNRELEASED are controlled by the game until their DLC comes out.

    Install

    1. Unzip into BlueStarManager\Mods (you get a CSS Order folder).
    2. In Blue Star Manager, enable it and place it below True CSSE and Separate, AI Skins! so it loads last.
    3. Launch the game. To change the order later, rebuild here and replace the files.
